subject: NovaConsumer RTO/RPO evidence & dependency timeline (SIG / CAIQ addendum)
messages:
From: Tamara Liu <tamara.liu@novaconsumer.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: security@novaconsumer.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: RTO/RPO evidence and third-party dependency map

Priyom —

Thanks for onboarding NovaConsumer for the SIG/CAIQ follow-up. Our security team is close to finalizing their assessment but we still need three specific items to close the BCP/DR section:

1) A short, machine-readable dependency timeline that lists critical third-party services (DNS, KMS, object storage, telemetry), expected failover sequencing, and the measured RTO/RPO from most recent warm-failover rehearsal. CSV is fine.

2) RPO/RTO artifacts (snapshots, timestamps, KV cache warm durations) tied to the last two failover tests — ideally with a short summary that calls out any variance from your published SLOs.

3) A runbook excerpt showing who is contacted at each step during a failover (ops contacts + phone/rotation), plus the proposed witness plan for a 90-minute live demo.

We know some items overlap with SOC2 evidence you shared earlier; we just need the dependency timeline and timestamps to map to our audit. If possible, please include any observed cold/warm cache fill times for the GPT inference path (kv cache rehydration).

Can you deliver a first-pass CSV + annotated PDF by EOD Wednesday PDT? We can schedule a short screen-share after that.

Thanks —
Tamara
Security Manager
NovaConsumer Inc.

[attachment: nova_sig_qa_v2.xlsx (xlsx) — referenced but we only need the timeline/metrics from you]
From: priyom.das@redwood.com <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Tamara Liu <tamara.liu@novaconsumer.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: RTO/RPO evidence and third-party dependency map

Tamara —

Thanks for the clear list. We can get you the CSV and a compact evidence packet by EOD Wednesday PD/T (we'll aim for the earliest slot so you have time to review). Plan: 

- I will attach a RPO/RTO summary PDF pulled from our replay logs (redwood_rpo_snapshot_20270914.pdf) showing the two most recent rehearsals and the observed KV rehydration windows for inference (these include token-level timing).
- Ops will supply a dependency_timeline_novaconsumer.csv that lists the service, region, order in failover, and measured recovery delta.
- Ben will provide an ops-runbook excerpt we can include as runbook_playback_excerpt.txt and a suggested witness agenda for the 90-minute live run.

Quick clarifying Qs for your team:
- For KMS, do you want the key rotation state at time of rehearsal included, or is a statement of key accessibility sufficient?
- Do you require signed timestamps (e.g., time-synced logs) vs. our internal log export? We can provide both if needed but will increase time to assemble.

Cc'ing Kimberly since procurement may need to confirm any witness NDAs or access scope for the live demo.

We should be able to meet the Wednesday evening PST delivery if there are no additional scope asks. If Raj (third-party vendor) needs any clarification on the dependency CSV format, loop him in.

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood_evidence_index.txt (txt) — index of items to follow]

To: priyom.das@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: RTO/RPO evidence and third-party dependency map

Priyom —

Thanks for taking point. Two things we should include with the deliverable (keeps audit questions short):

- A short timeline trace for the most recent warm-failover showing event timestamps (trigger -> kv rehydrate start -> kv at 80% -> routing stable). Even a 5-line timeline in the runbook excerpt will save the reviewer time.
- A statement of tolerances where we observed variance vs our SLOs (e.g., warm rehydration took 3.6s vs documented 3s) and an explanation (cache cold window on one host during the test).

Ops notes: if you pull the replay logs, redact any PII and include UTC timestamps.

Kimberly — please add procurement notes about the witness (NDA/addendum) if this turns into a live test request.

Ben
Senior Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: RTO/RPO evidence and third-party dependency map

Tamara —

Appended is a compact package that addresses your three asks. Highlights below and attachments are listed at the end:

- dependency_timeline_novaconsumer.csv — CSV with ordered dependencies (DNS, KMS, S3, telemetry), region, role, and observed recovery offset from trigger across our two most recent rehearsals (UTC).
- redwood_rpo_snapshot_20270914.pdf — two test snapshots with measured RTO/RPO, KV rehydration windows, and quick notes where values deviated from published SLOs.
- runbook_playback_excerpt.txt — 5-step excerpt with on-call contacts and witness agenda for a 90-minute live run.

Answering your Qs:
- KMS: we included key accessibility state and fingerprint at the time of rehearsal (not full rotation history). If you need the full rotation ledger, we can add it under a controlled disclosure.
- Signed timestamps: we included UTC-synced log exports and a signed manifest summary. If signed, cryptographic attestation is required we will need an addendum (DocuSign reference DOCUSIGN-REQ-48921).

If this looks good, can we pencil in a witness slot next week? Proposed: Tue 21 Sep, 14:00–15:30 PDT. Kimberly — can you confirm NDA addendum options and whether NovaConsumer needs an on-site engineer or a remote witness is sufficient?

Attached: dependency_timeline_novaconsumer.csv, redwood_rpo_snapshot_20270914.pdf, runbook_playback_excerpt.txt

Thanks —
Priyom Das
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
